# Kioku 0.7.7
- The notch no longer hides the end of a long name or title: each side of the island grows away from the notch instead of sliding under it. - The island is never shorter or narrower than the notch itself, so the hardware cannot show as a bump beside or below it. - A call found in a browser is named after the browser, not after one of its helper processes.

# Kioku 0.7.6
- The floating recording pill is replaced by a notch island: a black bar flush with the top of the screen that wraps the notch, or stands in for one on Macs without a notch. - When a call starts, the island shows the app's icon and name with a Record button and an ×. Right-click the × for Never for that app. - While recording, the island carries the recording dot, a live timer, a level meter and Stop. Messages open the island downward instead of a separate pop-up.

# Kioku 0.7.5
- Recordings stop safely into Recovery when storage is critically low or audio cannot be saved. Interrupted recordings recover their duration from the surviving audio. - Local saves preserve the original recording until the destination is ready. Damaged lesson details and recovery records no longer hide otherwise recoverable work. - Improved microphone reconnection and audio-format handling, with quiet, clipped, or missing-audio warnings in the recording pill. Selected call apps can reconnect to the CoreAudio capture after restarting. - Long recordings split into six-hour parts. Large audio files use bounded decoding and resumable transcription windows to reduce memory pressure. - Stalled transcription workers time out without blocking the interface. Queue writes reject competing or stale updates, and Ask rejects answers when their source lessons changed during generation. - Fixed the recording indicator freezing on later recordings and improved recovery after a failed stop or save.
These changes add safeguards without new settings or dependencies. Hardware interruptions and speech-recognition quality still depend on the device and recording conditions.

# Kioku 0.7.4
- Fixed old transfer records blocking two-Mac setup when this Mac's current role could not process them. - Changing from Recording Mac now offers to cancel unfinished transfers while keeping the recordings. Work already accepted by the transcription Mac must still be finished or resolved first. - Setup rechecks waiting work before restarting and keeps the current role if changes cannot be saved.

# Kioku 0.7.3
- Fixed a crash when Kioku started analysing a lesson, including automatic analysis after launch. - Fixed the same crash in Ask when using OpenAI.
